What each backend states on constant time, as the capability table read it:

* `botan`: Botan 3.14.1: doc/api_ref/hash.rst states no constant-time property of this hash, and its source (src/lib/hash/) none.
* `openssl`: OpenSSL 3.5.9: doc/man7/EVP_MD-*.pod, doc/man3/EVP_DigestInit.pod and providers/implementations/digests/ state no constant-time property.
* `xkcp`: XKCP at d20c8fc: README.markdown, lib/low/KeccakP-1600 and lib/high/Keccak (KeccakSponge, FIPS202/KeccakHash) state no constant-time property.

The default of `digests::keccak_224`, `digests::keccak_256`, `digests::keccak_384` and `digests::keccak_512`: `xkcp` on every target, whatever the program links; `botan`, `openssl` only where the call names it, as its second template argument (<<hash-default-backend>>).
